dialogues.speaker: Dunkhas
dialogues.text: That Varka... He's even more formidable than ever...

dialogues.speaker: Elishka
dialogues.text: *hic*... I'm done... I'm never drinking with him again...

response.speaker: Dunkhas
response.text: Don't worry, we're fine... Listen, kiddo, take this as a warning — don't ever try to outdrink the Grand Master. You won't win... I don't think he's even human!

response.speaker: Elishka
response.text: Hey! Who are you calling "kiddo"!? This is the Honorary Knight — show some respect!

response.speaker: Dunkhas
response.text: Oh-oh-oh-oh! My apologies — I'm not seeing straight right now. I didn't realize it was you, Honorary Knight.

response.speaker: Dunkhas
response.text: ...In fairness, all I really said is that you have a youthful glow, and energy, and... affability.

choices.text: (There's something not quite right with these two... Maybe I should make an effort to be nice?)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Have you two just returned to Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Elishka
response.text: That's right, we recently got transferred back... We haven't been working under Little Lady Gunnhildr for long.

response.speaker: Elishka
response.text: We've waited so long for a vacation, we thought we'd stop by and report to Varka!

response.speaker: Dunkhas
response.text: We only planned to buy him a couple of drinks — just a sign of respect — but that old dog outmaneuvered us. We can hardly ask Little Lady Gunnhildr for the night off over something this...

response.speaker: Dunkhas
response.text: ...Looking at it now, it's all pretty shameful. We really messed up!

response.speaker: Elishka
response.text: We have to make this up to her! We'll help handle all the training reports tomorrow. That way, she'll have a third less work to worry about.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Little Lady Gunnhildr...?

response.speaker: Elishka
response.text: Oh, I'm talking about the Acting Grand Master, Jean Gunnhildr — everyone feels at ease when she's around. She's the daughter of Lady Frederica!

response.speaker: Elishka
response.text: It's quite sad to think about, actually...

response.speaker: Elishka
response.text: Back when she was knee-high to a grasshopper, she'd stand outside the door to the headquarters, holding some test paper or other with a perfect score, waiting for Frederica to get off work...

response.speaker: Dunkhas
response.text: Then one day, even Frederica thought there was no need to be any more strict about her written grades... What was it she said?

response.speaker: Dunkhas
response.text: "It's okay to make mistakes every once in a while. You don't always need to get such high scores..."

response.speaker: Elishka
response.text: "Otherwise, the other parents will make you an example to scold your friends. Cultivating a positive image in the hearts of your peers is something all knights need to be mindful of."

response.speaker: Dunkhas
response.text: So, in her next round of exams, Little Lady Gunnhildr deliberately got one question wrong on every test. Just one question! Naturally, she was still top of the class, hahaha!

response.speaker: Elishka
response.text: Ah... Where does the time go? It seems like only yesterday!

response.speaker: Dunkhas
response.text: It really does... Hopefully, if we do our best to help handle the grunt work, in another couple of years, she might learn how to better conserve her energy...

response.speaker: Dunkhas
response.text: By that time, us two old-timers'll be about ready to retire, haha...

response.speaker: Elishka
response.text: With any luck, the youngsters coming through might possess half the drive and responsibility of Little Lady Gunnhildr!

choices.text: (Two drunken knights... Should I teach them a lesson?)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Getting drunk at this hour! That's outrageous!

response.speaker: Elishka
response.text: This hour... The day's still young, isn't it? We can probably fit in a couple more and still have time to sober up.

response.speaker: Elishka
response.text: We just finished reporting to Varka on our situation since being transferred back... It hasn't been long!

response.speaker: Dunkhas
response.text: But... Now that I think about it, Little Lady Gunnhildr is probably still hard at work.

response.speaker: Dunkhas
response.text: Urgh, this doesn't sit well with me... We really messed up!

response.speaker: Elishka
response.text: *hic*... Remember, we need to do more to help Little Lady Gunnhildr tomorrow...

response.speaker: Dunkhas
response.text: I'll remember...
